what: Section-name letters rise from the background color (invisible) to gold in .4s at .06s intervals from the first letter, then after .4s return to their own text color in .4s at the same intervals — finally the subtitle below drops in from 5px above after .8s in .6s Circ.easeOut. It can also run right on load (on: load) like a section header.

options.on: scroll (default — once when the section top reaches the bottom edge of the screen) or load (once after window load)
options.pad: in scroll, how many px more it must rise from the bottom edge of the screen before turning on, default 0
options.each: Gap between letters taking on color (sec), default .06
options.back: When the returning wave starts (seconds after the first letter begins to color), default .4
options.fade: If on, text opacity is also raised from 0 along with it (like the vertical Section heading)
options.sub-delay: Delay (s) before the subtitle starts to settle in, default .8
options.--fx-from: Starting text color (via style), default --kf-bg — same as the background so the text is invisible, then floats up
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Line to split into characters — whole element if empty

use: Shop InfoFind a store
note: Words are wrapped in inline-block chunks to keep spaces (so multi-line Korean titles do not break mid-word). For the vertical title in the lower section header, the original ran dur .8·each .04·each-back .08 and started the second wave .7s before the first wave ended — giving back as (char count − 1) × .04 + .1 matches it
